subhead: As Russian bombings intensify and air defenses weaken, a growing number of the Ukrainian capital's residents are heading underground at nightfall as a precaution, without waiting for possible alerts.

title: France, Germany and UN condemn Israeli minister Ben-Gvir's 'inhumane' call to kill Gazans
subhead: Far-right national security minister Itamar Ben-Gvir said Israel should 'take out 30 or 40' people in Gaza per night, prompting protests from Paris, Berlin and the United Nations.

title: Nicolas Altmayer, producer of hit French comedies, dies at 61
subhead: A key figure in French cinema, Nicolas Altmayer co-founded Mandarin & Compagnie with his brother, Eric. The production company backed 'Brice de Nice,' 'OSS 117,' and 10 films by François Ozon. He died on August 17 at age 61.

title: Jean Hegland, American novelist: 'The idea that humans must dominate the Earth and animals has not served us well'
subhead: In an interview with Le Monde, the author of the cult novel 'Into the Forest' calls for thinking beyond infinite growth, which she sees as incompatible with protecting the living world.

title: Why are heatwaves becoming more frequent in France?
subhead: Between May and July, France was the most abnormally hot country in the world, compared to its average heat index. While the role of global warming is not under debate, the frequency of this summer's heatwaves is a topic of scientific debate.
